main.title: Divinity: Original Sin II
main.subtitle: Source, choices and a world that reacts
main.summary: Divinity: Original Sin II is a 2017 role-playing video game by Larian Studios.

cards.heading: A Godwoken among the threats to Rivellon
cards.text: Divinity: Original Sin II is a 2017 role-playing video game by Larian Studios. The sequel to Divinity: Original Sin (2014) and the fifth main entry in the Divinity series, the game was originally released for Windows in September 2017. The player controls a "Godwoken", a persecuted user of a powerful magic known as Source, and becomes a pivotal figure in the fight against the Voidwoken, which are monstrous creatures who wreak havoc in the medieval fantasy world of Rivellon.

cards.heading: Tactical combat and shared adventures
cards.text: Divinity: Original Sin II features turn-based tactical RPG combat played from an isometric perspective. The game focuses on character development, exploration and interactions with non-player characters (NPCs), allowing players to make decisions that impact the story and the world. A flexible quest system enables various approaches to resolving quests. Original Sin II was conceived to work as both a single-player or cooperative multiplayer game, and players can play alone controlling a party of one to four Godwoken, or in a group of two to four players dividing the playable characters between them.

cards.heading: Crowdfunding and success
cards.text: A Kickstarter campaign raised two million dollars for Original Sin II. The finished game sold more than a million copies in two months and received praise for its writing, flexible quests, tactical combat, cooperative play and music. The expanded Definitive Edition reached Windows, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in 2018, followed by other platforms.

main.title: Metroid: Samus Returns
main.subtitle: MercurySteam / Nintendo EPD · Nintendo 3DS
main.summary: Metroid: Samus Returns is MercurySteam and Nintendo's Nintendo 3DS reimagining of Metroid II. Samus Aran descends into SR388 to eliminate the Metroids, searching a planet whose tunnels conceal different stages of the creatures' development. Equipment expands her movement and access as the hunt advances. The story follows the earlier Game Boy journey, but three-dimensional scenery, new rooms and revised encounters change its physical character. The side-view adventure gives Samus more precise control over her weapons and another answer to an enemy approaching at close range.

cards.heading: Returning to the Metroid homeworld
cards.text: Metroid: Samus Returns is MercurySteam and Nintendo's Nintendo 3DS reimagining of Metroid II. Samus Aran descends into SR388 to eliminate the Metroids, searching a planet whose tunnels conceal different stages of the creatures' development. Equipment expands her movement and access as the hunt advances. The story follows the earlier Game Boy journey, but three-dimensional scenery, new rooms and revised encounters change its physical character. The side-view adventure gives Samus more precise control over her weapons and another answer to an enemy approaching at close range.

cards.heading: Aim freely, then answer a charge
cards.text: Samus can stand still and aim around a full circle, choosing the angle needed to reach an exposed target. The Melee Counter provides a different kind of precision: recognising the signal before a physical attack and responding at the right moment can stun the attacker. Both actions encourage attention to an enemy's position and behaviour. A fight becomes easier when the player identifies the opening, rather than merely firing into the space ahead while trying to avoid everything that enters it.

cards.heading: Finding what the rock conceals
cards.text: Aeion abilities draw on a separate energy supply. Scan Pulse reveals nearby map information and hidden passages, giving the player a means of investigating a promising but apparently closed area. Other abilities assist fighting or movement, while transport stations shorten return journeys through the growing map. MercurySteam developed the game under the supervision of longtime Metroid producer Yoshio Sakamoto. Its combination of counters, free aiming and side-view exploration preceded the studio's later work with Nintendo on Metroid Dread, which carried those ideas into a new mission.

main.title: Golf Story
main.subtitle: An adventure played with a golf club
main.summary: Golf Story is Sidebar Games' golfing role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 28 September 2017.

cards.heading: An adventure played with a golf club
cards.text: Golf Story is Sidebar Games' golfing role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 28 September 2017. A golfer returns to the sport he loved as a child and attempts to build a career among the courses and communities surrounding it. Matches sit within a larger world of conversations, odd jobs and comic disputes. The club is useful beyond a formal round, allowing the player to take shots around the landscape and discover how golf can become the means of completing an adventure.

cards.heading: A shot can solve more than a hole
cards.text: A three-click system determines the direction, power and accuracy of a shot. Club choice, distance and the ground around the ball affect the approach to each hole. Between rounds, challenges provide money and experience that improve the golfer's abilities and equipment. Because shots can be played outside the courses, an obstacle or request in the surrounding world may be answered with the same action used on the fairway. Learning the sport also expands what the player can accomplish while exploring.

cards.heading: The course becomes part of a community
cards.text: Eight areas provide courses, side activities and characters whose problems give the next match a personal context. Disc golf, miniature golf and other variations change the scale or equipment while retaining the pleasure of judging a trajectory. Joel Steudler composed the music. The Game Boy Color Mario Golf helped inspire Sidebar's approach, but Golf Story builds its own comic community around the sport. Progress means improving a score and gradually finding a place among the people who care, argue or obsess about the game.

main.title: Star Fox 2
main.subtitle: The future that waited
main.summary: A cancelled Super NES sequel finally reaches players in 2017, carrying a different idea of how to defend a galaxy.

cards.heading: A second chance for Lylat
cards.text: Star Fox 2 first received an official release with the Super NES Classic on September 29, 2017. Nintendo had developed it during the 1990s, then cancelled it as the market moved towards newer 3D hardware. In Nintendo’s retrospective, Shigeru Miyamoto described expensive cartridge technology and awkward timing, rather than a game rejected by its players. The 2017 release lets that interrupted branch of the series speak for itself.

cards.heading: More than a flight path
cards.text: Instead of following a fixed sequence of stages, two chosen pilots defend Corneria on a map of the Lylat system, intercepting missiles and enemy forces. Battles interrupt that strategic view, but threats continue to advance while the player fights. Fox, Falco, Peppy and Slippy are joined by Miyu and Fay; their craft have different strengths. Transforming the Arwing into a Walker allows ground exploration and switches inside enemy installations. A successful sortie is also a decision about where not to be.

main.title: Cuphead
main.subtitle: A debt drawn by hand
main.summary: Cuphead is a 2017 run and gun game developed and published independently by Studio MDHR.

cards.heading: A debt to the Devil
cards.text: Cuphead is a 2017 run and gun game developed and published independently by Studio MDHR. The game follows its titular cup-head character and his brother Mugman, as they make a deal with the Devil to pay casino losses by repossessing the souls of runaway debtors. In the game, up to two players control Cuphead or Mugman to fight through several levels and boss fights; the game does not have a rigid narrative structure. As the game progresses, the protagonist acquires more power and abilities, eventually facing the Devil. Players, however, can only equip a limited number of these abilities at a given time.

cards.heading: Traditional animation and a big-band score
cards.text: The game's creators, brothers Chad and Jared Moldenhauer, took inspiration from the rubber hose animation style from the golden age of American animation and the surrealist qualities of the works of Walt Disney Animation Studios, Fleischer Studios, Warner Bros. Cartoons, MGM Cartoon Studio and Walter Lantz Productions. Reminiscent of the aesthetics of the 1930s and the Jazz Age, the game is noted for its animation and soundtrack. All in-game assets were created through traditional animation with deliberate human imperfections, and the soundtrack was written for and recorded with a full big band.

cards.heading: Success beyond the original release
cards.text: Cuphead was announced in 2013 and shown at E3 in 2014 before its 2017 Windows and Xbox One launch. It sold a million copies within two weeks and five million within two years. Reviews praised its animation, music and demanding boss battles, and it won three Game Awards. The Delicious Last Course expansion followed in June 2022, while The Cuphead Show! brought the characters to Netflix earlier that year.

main.title: Forza Motorsport 7
main.subtitle: The Track Changes as You Learn It
main.summary: Forza Motorsport 7 brings more than seven hundred cars, changing weather and Forzavista inspection to Xbox One and Windows 10.

cards.heading: Turn 10 returns to the circuit
cards.text: Forza Motorsport 7 is Turn 10?s racing game for Xbox One and Windows 10, released worldwide on October 3, 2017. More than seven hundred cars and over thirty racing environments support competitions, collecting and customisation. Changing weather and track conditions affect how a race develops.

cards.heading: Driving in changing conditions
cards.text: A familiar braking point can become less reliable when the track turns wet. Drivers must adjust their speed, steering and acceleration to the conditions. Learning a circuit involves recognising these changes as well as remembering its corners.

cards.heading: A varied garage
cards.text: Different vehicles bring different weight, power and engine layouts to the same circuit. Switching cars means adjusting braking and acceleration, even on a well-known route. Events organised by vehicle groups give the collection a practical role in progression.

cards.heading: Looking closer with Forzavista
cards.text: Forzavista lets players examine cars away from the circuit. Bodywork, interiors and mechanical details can be studied without racing against a clock. It complements the driving with a closer look at the vehicles in the garage.

main.title: Gran Turismo Sport
main.subtitle: Competition Becomes a Championship
main.summary: Gran Turismo Sport is a 2017 sim racing video game developed by Polyphony Digital and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment for the PlayStation 4.

cards.heading: Gran Turismo Arrives on PlayStation 4
cards.text: Gran Turismo Sport is a 2017 sim racing video game developed by Polyphony Digital and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment for the PlayStation 4. It is the twelfth game in the Gran Turismo series. The October 17 date refers to the North American release; Europe followed on October 18.

cards.heading: Competition and Updates
cards.text: Competitive online racing is central to Gran Turismo Sport. The FIA supported its international championship, with races forming the basis of the FIA-Certified Gran Turismo Championships. At launch, the game offered 40 course configurations across 17 locations. Free updates added a more traditional single-player campaign and expanded the selection to 338 cars and 82 configurations by July 2021.

cards.heading: The End of Online Services
cards.text: Gran Turismo Sport was followed by Gran Turismo 7, which was released on March 4, 2022. The game's online services were permanently discontinued on January 31, 2024, with all DLCs delisted on the PlayStation Store on December 1, 2023.
